situation (example wording): "Carjackings in Texas in 2024" (a state or national sum), amending P85's coverage columns
what the app does today: The table always has "Agencies reporting" (or "Consistent Reporting Agencies") and "Population covered" columns.
proposed behavior: The two coverage columns are shown only when the question asks for the agencies reporting ("..., with the number of agencies reporting"); otherwise the table is the figure alone. The figures are still carried with the answer, and the Consistent Reporting Agencies view names its agencies in its first sentence.
why: The columns crowded every state answer; the one-sentence note and the Consistent Reporting Agencies offer say what a reader needs.
status: Decided 2026-11-01 (Jeff, through the coordinator: "coverage columns only on request")
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts.
